back_blocks.md: **Diffraction** is the spreading out of waves as they pass through a gap (aperture) or around the edge of an obstacle.

cards.back_md: **Diffraction** is the spreading out of waves as they pass through a gap (aperture) or around the edge of an obstacle.

front_blocks.md: Diffraction is most pronounced when the width of the gap and the **..........** of the wave are similar in size.

back_blocks.md: Diffraction is most pronounced when the width of the gap and the **wavelength** of the wave are similar in size.

cards.front_md: Diffraction is most pronounced when the width of the gap and the **..........** of the wave are similar in size.
cards.back_md: Diffraction is most pronounced when the width of the gap and the **wavelength** of the wave are similar in size.

front_blocks.md: What is the only property of a wave that changes when it is diffracted, and why?

back_blocks.md: Its **amplitude** decreases, because some energy is dissipated as the wave passes through the gap. The wavelength (and frequency) stay constant.

cards.front_md: What is the only property of a wave that changes when it is diffracted, and why?
cards.back_md: Its **amplitude** decreases, because some energy is dissipated as the wave passes through the gap. The wavelength (and frequency) stay constant.

front_blocks.md: Besides passing through a narrow gap, in what other situation can diffraction occur?

back_blocks.md: Waves can also diffract by curving around the edge of a barrier or obstacle.

cards.front_md: Besides passing through a narrow gap, in what other situation can diffraction occur?
cards.back_md: Waves can also diffract by curving around the edge of a barrier or obstacle.

front_blocks.md: Compare the diffraction of a wave through a gap that is much bigger than its wavelength with one much smaller than its wavelength.

back_blocks.md:
- Gap much **bigger** than the wavelength: little diffraction, the wave passes through largely undeviated
- Gap much **smaller** than the wavelength: the wave spreads out significantly after passing through

front_blocks.md: Only water waves and sound waves can be diffracted; light waves cannot.

back_blocks.md: Any type of wave can be diffracted, including light.

cards.front_md:
True or False?

Only water waves and sound waves can be diffracted; light waves cannot.
cards.back_md:
**False.**

Any type of wave can be diffracted, including light.

front_blocks.md: Name a piece of apparatus used to demonstrate diffraction of water waves, and describe how the amount of diffraction can be varied in this experiment.

back_blocks.md: A **ripple tank**. The amount of diffraction can be varied by changing the size of the gap relative to the wavelength of the waves.
